images.prompt: Use case: product-mockup / stylized-concept. Create an original premium editorial still life for a contemporary Korean tea atlas, square composition, high-resolution crisp image. Refined dimensional ceramic rendering mixed with very subtle Korean ink-wash botanical painting, warm ivory hanji paper background, quiet asymmetry and generous empty space, soft daylight from the left, tactile porcelain and gentle shadows. One handleless Korean tea cup, no saucer, no Japanese matcha tools, no teapot needed, delicate restrained black five-rounded-petal outline flower with one center dot on the cup exterior. The cup in lower middle foreground, source ingredient artfully displayed beside it. Very pale celadon and baekja white palette, actual tea's color distinct and believable, shallow elliptical liquid surface clearly visible. Simple paper-and-stone setting with faint ink-wash mountain silhouettes far in the background; no large landscape competing with the tea. No text, lettering, labels, UI or watermark. The liquid is normal tea, not shell or glitter. Subject: NOKCHA, Korean green leaf tea. A baekja-white porcelain cup of transparent pale yellow-green tea, a few slender processed dry green tea leaves on folded hanji beside it and one small botanical Camellia sinensis sprig of pointed serrated green leaves. Fresh green restrained palette; no matcha powder, no whisk, no fruit.
